scheme: independent composition bootstrap; all rows carried; paired skill uses same OOD draws
composition_counts: n_compositions counts original task-eligible compositions; n_sampled_compositions counts full sampling universe. X draws from full universe then excludes BASELINE rows.
rng: numpy default_rng; SeedSequence.spawn(2), child 0 IID, child 1 OOD
ci: 95% percentile; finite replicates only; linear quantile
liquid_single_class: F1 defined with zero_division=0; AP undefined
x_policy: exclude BASELINE only; reject nonfinite nonBASELINE targets; no zero fill
